items.detail: Assurance of discontinuance in Suffolk Superior Court over abusive debt collection and improper charges to MassHealth members; date is the announcement date. The $2.5 million is total relief as headlined: $500,000 paid to the state, about $2.1 million of consumer judgments to be vacated, and over $9,000 in refunds to MassHealth consumers. Cash-only rule applied 2026-10-11: amount changed from 2,500,000 to 509,000; the part not counted is listed in data/manual/excluded-amounts.csv as xa-015.
